caption:
sunday is the cheapest hour I spend all week

#sundayreset #mealprep #routine

slides.text:
Sunday decides
what Tuesday looks like

It reads what's
in the fridge

And tells me what to cook

Snacks made at home

So 4pm isn't a decision

Kit washed, bag packed

Monday morning has
nothing left to argue with

Then I stop

The reset is not
another workout

slides.heading: One hour buys the whole week
slides.body: SOMA plans the week from your own data — the meals, the sessions and the days you are meant to do nothing
